title: arabis hirsuta var. glabrescens
intro: Arabis hirsuta var. glabrescens, commonly known as hairy rockcress, is a plant species within the Brassicaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of hairy rockcress include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use as a natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Arabis hirsuta var. glabrescens include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
